items.q: What makes you different from other operators?
items.a: We are a Thimphu-based, locally owned team. Every guide is licensed and Bhutanese, every itinerary is designed in-house, and we put a share of each booking back into the villages you visit — in line with Gross National Happiness.

items.q: What kinds of trips do you run?
items.a: Cultural tours, festival trips, treks, luxury journeys and family holidays — all private, and all adjustable. Solo, couple or group, we plan around you.

Pick a package (or ask for a custom one), send us an enquiry, and we'll confirm dates and a quote within 24 hours. Once you pay the deposit we apply for your visa, book flights and hotels, and send you a full travel pack.

items.q: Can you arrange hotels and transport?
items.a: Yes. All packages include tourism-certified hotels, a private vehicle with driver, and a licensed guide. We can also book Drukair or Bhutan Airlines flights into Paro.
Bhutan is one of the safest countries in Asia, with very low crime. The main things to plan for are altitude on mountain passes and winding roads — your guide will pace the trip accordingly.
Layers, a rain jacket, comfortable walking shoes, and modest clothing (long sleeves and long trousers or skirt) for visiting dzongs and temples. See our full packing list in the Travel Guide.
